title: An image slot's minimum file width is capped at the template's own picture and never below its box
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A 1078 px box with a 1408 px template file gets minWidth 1408, not 1617.
1.5 x box when the file is wider or unmeasured; the box width when the file is narrower than the box.

tests: a class photo the old rule kept becomes replaceable, with the box of each viewport and its shape
the minimum file width is one and a half times the box, capped at the template file, never below the box
